description: REEF3D is the REEF3D developers' parallel hydrodynamics software for marine, coastal and hydraulic-engineering flows. Its solver family includes CFD, non-hydrostatic, potential-flow and shallow-flow configurations, with wave, sediment-transport and fluid-structure capabilities. Inputs are computational domains, physical properties and initial or boundary conditions; outputs are simulated water motion and associated engineering quantities. Spatial resolution and duration depend on the chosen solver and case. Source is free under GPL-3.0-or-later, as stated in the repository, with a linked user guide and examples. A limitation is that selecting a solver appropriate to the flow scale and physics remains the user's responsibility; the project currently does not accept outside contributions. REEF3D can assess coastal defence, port and offshore-energy scenarios. OpenFOAM (model-openfoam) is related CFD software. This review inspected repository documentation only and did not download the guide PDF, model cases or executable software.
